name: Zefron API
description: Deno music API with Telegram delivery and MongoDB-backed audio caching.

MONGODB_URI.description: MongoDB connection string for the persistent audio cache and per-user API keys.

TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token used to upload cached audio.

TELEGRAM_OUTPUT_BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram output bot token used to issue per-user API keys and deliver songs.

TELEGRAM_CACHE_CHANNEL_ID.description: Telegram channel ID where cached audio is stored.

TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID.description: Optional Telegram admin chat or user ID.

YUKI_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for the Yuki audio source fallback.

YUKI_STREAM_BASE_URL.description: Optional Yuki stream endpoint base URL.
